title: feat: add large tab button size
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds a reusable `lg` size to the shared Package UI `TabButton`.
- Uses the existing size map without changing the default `md` behavior.
- Enables larger high-level selectors while preserving current tabs.

Checks:
- `npm run typecheck`
- `npm run test`
- `npm run build`

gist.headline: Tabs got room to breathe
gist.blurb: The shared tab buttons grew a new large size. Bigger selectors for the moments when a tiny rectangle is simply not enough.
gist.summary: Added a reusable `lg` size to the shared Package UI `TabButton`, preserving the existing `md` default for current tabs.
gist.impact: Interfaces using the shared UI package can now offer larger high-level tab selectors without changing existing tab layouts.
gist.visual_concept: Polli, wearing tiny designer glasses, carefully places a larger lime-green tab on a cozy retro interface while small code-plants grow around the monitor; the scene represents a shared UI component gaining an optional larger control without disturbing existing tabs.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush, light blue wings, and tiny designer glasses, adjusting a large lime green (#ecf874) tab button on a warm CRT monitor while smaller tabs sit neatly beside it and code-plants sprout from pots below. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, subtle pixel-font text: 'LG TAB'. Nostalgic but beautiful, emotionally warm.
